summary: @servicetitan/log-service preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script invokes `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub (oven-sh/bun releases), extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and then uses the newly-downloaded Bun binary to execute a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~728KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) using string-array-rotation obfuscation (function `WV8StW` rotating a large mixed literal/opcode array `n7gIxM`) and hex-mangled identifiers, with contents that do not correspond to the package's stated purpose (a React log-service library). `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with hex-mangled variable names (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, `_0x19328d`) and object-wrapped string constants, and probes `/etc/os-release` for Alpine/musl to pick a matching Bun variant. The alternate-runtime-dropper shape — install-time fetch of a second language runtime specifically to execute an opaque, obfuscated bundle unrelated to the package's advertised functionality — runs attacker-controlled code on any host that installs the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
